title: feat(theme): add default themes using css-modules
body:
This PR lets you have a first look at what using css-modules for default theming could look like. I modify the examples to use them. 

You also can run storybook (npm run storybook), to see how the widgets looks like. 
The widgets that has default theme are SearchBox, Pagination, RangeRatings, Range. 

Warning : 
- tests are not working yet. 
- props docs generation was commented because of some issues with css-modules loader.
